name: Natsuru
source:
The protagonist of this work. (nameable)
One of the four people with the special abilities from the Setou Underground Science Institution.
Natsuru wakes up in the underground laboratory and  finds out that he had lost his memories. In the laboratory he meets four people with who seem to know him. 

[Roughly translated from [url=http://cla.velvet.jp/kasou1.htm]the official site[/url].]
translation:
The protagonist of this work. (nameable)
One of the four people with the special abilities from the Setou Underground Science Institution.
Natsuru wakes up in the underground laboratory and  finds out that he had lost his memories. In the laboratory he meets four people with who seem to know him.
